page.overview:
Who is Dr. Walter?

Dr. Walter was a Soviet scientist sent to aid Sir Hugo Drax with the "Moonraker" missile project and its atomic warhead. He appears in the third Ian Fleming novel Moonraker.

Dr Walter first met Hugo Drax when he was assigned to aid him in developing the "Moonraker" Missile.

The Soviet scientist first met Bond when Drax was touring him (Bond) throughout the Moonraker facility along with Willy Krebs and calls him "Dr Walter". Dr Walter then proceeds to correct Drax by saying his name is pronounced "Valter".

Dr Walter (along with a disguised Soviet Sub) picked up both Hugo Drax and Krebs in an attempt to flee the UK. Unfortunately for them, they met his untimely death when Bond (with the help of Gala Brand) changed the coordinates of the Moonraker missile from London, to their location. Dr Walter, along with Drax, Krebs, and 200 of the UK Coast guard and Navy, were incinerated in the blast. ----
